$HOFF (HoffStock Token) is the community token of HoffStock, a non-custodial interface for asset-backed liquidity on Robinhood Chain, built on Morpho Blue. It is a plain ERC-20.

$HOFF has no role in the lending protocol. Holding it does not change interest rates, borrow limits, oracle policy or access to any market. HoffStock makes no statement about its price, supply or holders beyond what the token contract itself reports on-chain.
This token powers the competitive side of Clash Card. If you play in our tournaments or rank up on the platform, $CC is what you will be earning.

Launch a token paired with stocks or any coin on the chain, from NVDA and Tesla to CashCat, Musebook and Mushroom. You choose what it trades against

All proceeds from the main token’s 3% transaction tax go toward buying back and burning the main token
